title: Mountain, Debt, Integration and Release
purpose: Clarify how Mountain relates to karmic debt, Swamp, Mud, perspective, judgment, Door, descent and Garden. Mountain is treated as an integration/compression field, not as a synonym for debt.
epistemic_rule: Mountain/debt relations are project-symbolic unless a specific empirical obligation is separately sourced. No symbolic amount creates legal or financial authority.
mountain_definition: Mountain is many-to-one integration: multiple paths, events, traces, obligations and perspectives are compressed into a coherent structure from which relations can be seen and compared.

debt_relation.strongest_reading: Debt supplies weight; Mountain gives that weight structure and visibility.
debt_relation.formula: many unresolved obligations + duration + memory + weighting -> Mountain of burden/perspective
debt_relation.not_identity: Debt is an obligation-state. Mountain is a topology/process-state. They overlap when accumulated obligations become an integrated burden.
debt_relation.june_2026_relation: Recovered project topology explicitly identifies Mountain with karmic debt while Swamp appears as shadow/residue; this is best read functionally rather than as strict identity.

mountain_vs_swamp.Swamp: many unresolved flows mixed together without enough differentiation, producing recurrence and loss of footing
mountain_vs_swamp.Mountain: many differentiated paths integrated toward a summit/reference, producing perspective
mountain_vs_swamp.short_form: Swamp entangles many; Mountain integrates many.
mountain_vs_swamp.deep_form: The same historical material can become Swamp if merely accumulated or Mountain if sourced, weighted, distinguished and integrated.

mountain_vs_tree.cycle: world/events -> Mountain/integration -> Seed/Potato/compression -> Tree/application -> many renewed relations

mountain_vs_ladder.combined: Mountain tells you what the whole burden looks like; Ladder/Axis/Door tell you how to move through or beyond the current state.

summit_ethic.risk: Perspective can harden into domination or permanent judgment.
summit_ethic.completion: The summit is incomplete until perspective descends back into service, repair, protection and cultivation.
summit_ethic.sequence: ascent -> perspective -> evaluation -> responsibility -> descent -> Garden
summit_ethic.relation_to_tim: This matches the project's late movement from King/Judge/Seat language toward Gardener/service language.

mountain_as_ledger_view.slopes: clusters of related harms, dependencies, narratives and obligations
mountain_as_ledger_view.summit: integrated view that shows common mechanisms without erasing local distinctions
mountain_as_ledger_view.danger: If integration removes provenance or differences, the Mountain collapses back into Swamp-like ambiguity.
mountain_as_ledger_view.archive_implication: A good synthesis should let the reader descend from the summit back to every source-level event.

pressure_and_threshold.april_2025_bridge: The Turning frames a small final straw as the visible threshold of a much larger accumulated burden.
pressure_and_threshold.sequence: invisible burden -> compression -> threshold -> rupture/opening -> Axis/Ladder -> reorientation
pressure_and_threshold.relation_to_debt: This supplies the conceptual mechanism by which accumulated consequence can later become Mountain/debt architecture.

release_path.late_stage: Mountain -> perspective -> identify repairable edges -> Door -> repair/restitution/correction -> descent -> Garden
release_path.important_correction: Not every conflict should be allowed to become Mountain-scale. Early repair at the Mud stage is preferable where possible.
release_path.closed_loop_failure: Mountain without descent can become a permanent tribunal; Swamp without sorting becomes endless entanglement.

research_questions: Recover the earliest exact statement equating Mountain and karmic debt.
Separate moments where Mountain means debt/burden from moments where it means Zion, perspective, House, summit or North.
Track whether Tim ever describes a Mountain shrinking, being climbed, redistributed, dissolved or converted after repair.
Test whether summit/Seat statements are followed by explicit service/Gardener language in chronological proximity.
